primary.title: Are Income plus arbitrage funds a good investment choice? Returns explained
primary.summary: After attracting nearly ₹21,000 crore in 2025, income plus arbitrage funds saw investors withdraw around ₹2,000 crore during the first seven months of 2026 through 31 July, according to MFI360 Explorer.
